Messages.Author: Jozxyqk
Messages.Body:
OK, so with the new Kiss of Ra wording saying that the block attempt is
canceled and the current action is ended, instead of "this action is still
blocked", can you follow up a Kiss of Ra with a Freak Drive at inferior?
Is the action considered *unblocked*?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


The Kissed action is not blocked.
But inferior Freak Drive wants success (card text).
The Kissed action is not successful.

http://groups.google.com/groups?selm=3DFE05D1.C7426D10%40white-wolf.com
(Google: "ended kiss author:LSJ")

So Freak Drive cannot be used.

1) Top-posting makes it difficult to follow the conversation.

2) Correct. A minion only taps for three things: taking an action, successfully
blocking an action, and explicit card text. The victim of Kiss of Ra doesn't
fall under any of those.
